import Foundation precedencegroup PowerPrecedence { higherThan: MultiplicationPrecedence } infix operator **: PowerPrecedence @available(iOS 13.0, *) public struct Box<T> { public var value: T let count: Int = 42 var ratio: Double = 1.5e-3 public init(value: T) { self.value = value } public subscript(index: Int) -> T? { return index == 0 ? value : nil } public func describe(name label: String, _ extra: Int = 0) -> String { let raw = #"raw \n string"# let multi = """ line one line two """ let label2 = "name=\(label) count=\(count)" let tuple = (x: 1, y: 2) let hex = 0x1f, bin = 0b1010 if count > 0 && !label.isEmpty { print(raw, multi, label2, tuple.x, hex, bin) } return label2 } } extension Box: Equatable where T: Equatable { static func == (lhs: Box, rhs: Box) -> Bool { return lhs.value == rhs.value } } func operator ** (base: Double, power: Double) -> Double { return pow(base, power) }
